verdict.rationale: SAR preparation is a fair axis for an AML compliance platform. The evidence shows case management, case decisions, case audit trails and generic data exports (e.g. SCREENING_AND_MONITORING_CASES, TRANSACTION_MONITORING_CASES_AND_ALERTS, transaction CSV), but nothing documents building a suspicious-activity report, let alone a jurisdiction-specific SAR/STR template or filing. Those exports and audit logs are adjacent features that do not count toward this story.
